title: Payment and refund workers not completing

events.summary: Weekday catch-up: leftover sale captures plus refunds for weekend duplicate-charge tickets.
payment_completed_rps and refund_completed_rps fall together over ~90 seconds.
Refund for invoice-8841 remains In progress in the merchant dashboard. Checkout for a new Harbor Bike order sits on AUTHORIZED.
Alert PaymentCompletionsLow: payment_completed_rps < 1 for 5 minutes. Second alert RefundCompletionsLow 20s later.
Ack. Health UP. Canary process pid 4412 still running. HTTP request threads accept connections; several /payments and /refunds calls older than 30s.
Joins. Asks for dashboard, then logs, then a thread dump of pid 4412. Notes CPU is low.
Stabilization options discussed: drain LB, bounce canary, pause refunds. Not executed in this teaching timeline — student decides.

openQuestions: Are workers blocked, spinning, or just starved of tasks?
Is JDBC or an outbound HTTP call involved?
Did both payment and refund stop because they share a dependency?
